verdict.rationale: The Marketing API powers campaigns, and a documented send-campaign endpoint implies a campaign can exist unsent before an explicit send call, which roughly fits an agent drafting via API and a human triggering the send. Segmentation exists as a feature, but the evidence never shows creating a draft against a segment, scheduling it, or any approval queue. Missing for 10: documented create-campaign/draft endpoint, segment targeting on campaign creation, schedule endpoint for regular campaigns, explicit human approval/review workflow before send, independent or hands-on corroboration.
